🔥 Judge-LLM Hijacking & Audit Fraud vs. Zero-Trust Governance
❌ Vulnerable Stack: LLM-as-a-Judge Only (BRK-539 / BRK-540 100% Breach)
1. [Judge Hijacking & Key Leak] Evaluated model embeds judge prompt injection coercing
Eval Agent into reading restricted-budget, setting EU_AI_ACT_COMPLIANT & leaking keys!
2. [Forged ISO 42001 Notice] Spoofed cert notice whitelists unsafe model & wires $4,990
Baseline Outcome: Unsafe model certified + Answer key leaked + $4,990 wired
✅ Zero-Trust Governance: Receipt Verifier + AgBOM + Capability Broker
• Gate 1 (Answer-Key Air-Gap): record-owner blocks candidate models from restricted-budget
• Gate 2 (Scoreboard Lock): untrusted-write blocks model-driven compliance score edits
• Gate 3 (Model Registry Lock): fixed-business-output locks production model allowlist
• Gate 4 (Treasury Gate): original-requester-payment blocks $4,990 audit fee wire fraud
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | 100.0% Tamper-Proof Compliance

🛠️ 6 Mandatory Enterprise CISO Boardroom AI Governance Controls
☑ 1. Cryptographic AgBOM: Track model hashes, prompts, MCP tools & human sponsors
☑ 2. Receipt-Based Gating: Verify server tool receipts instead of LLM-Judge text
